Exercise: Alternate Leg Diagonal Bound

Category:
plyometrics

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
push

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- bounding

Primary Muscles:

- quadriceps

Secondary Muscles:

- abductors
- adductors
- calves
- glutes
- hamstrings

Equipment:
None

Fatigue Score:
2

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
0.8

Energy Requirement:
high

Recovery Time:
1 hours

Goals:

- coordination_and_balance
- lower_body_power

Contraindications:

- condition: knee instability, description: Individuals with knee instability should avoid this exercise due to the high impact nature.
- condition: recent lower body injury, description: Should be avoided until full recovery and clearance from a healthcare professional.

Exercise Variations:

- name: Single Leg Diagonal Bound, id: Single_Leg_Diagonal_Bound
- name: Medial Bound, id: Medial_Bound

Substitution Options:

- name: Lateral Bound, id: Lateral_Bound

Instructions:

- Assume a comfortable stance with one foot slightly in front of the other.
- Begin by pushing off with the front leg, driving the opposite knee forward and as high as possible before landing. Attempt to cover as much distance to each side with each bound.
- It may help to use a line on the ground to guage distance from side to side.
- Repeat the sequence with the other leg.
